# Fixed m7 original-trace Bernstein candidate

PREPARATION ONLY / NOT_ADMITTED. Author EM-DIRECT-88303D, own SID MCP-80ce72c19cb84e508513c39e73540a9c, RA-1E650208FBE6654C7D59AB55. Genuine seven-event closure is Source990fedac28fe16199145cc3b7002d3315323fe37: direct activity allowed, Task authorized=false. Root authorized this code/input preparation but forbids scientific invocation, import/compilation tests, coefficient generation and parameter samples. None has occurred. This candidate creates no Task/claim, discovery, result or Native vote.

This is the concrete computational successor to the one already reviewed m7 combined unit, not another failure-of-criterion paper. The mathematical question is the ACTUAL complete signed scalar G(r)=tr(B^(-1)A)-6 on ALL real r in [7,8], with a=c=1,m=7,n=6,r=7(S+1). The reviewed large-r bound begins at7^100 and leaves this interval open. Printed-threshold comparisons or old m3..6/finite sign fixtures do not answer this question. No old checker is invoked or adapted.

## Exact mathematical input and correctness obligation

FIXED_INPUT.json pins all four implementation files, five consumed source bodies(51407B), and the immutable capsule of the two inner members. The beta kernel/self-audit supply the complete trace bridge; Source22338e996c7908348438efb449dcf5d8f700a0f7 equation(7) supplies Xi and degree<=14. BFF6DC's actual report/binding at Source18bbd58031fefb48a85ff6d95b600610bc404bc4 validate those premises only, not this code, compact sign or execution. The worker rehashes code then compiles only those same cached bytes.

Set V(x)=product_(a=1)^7(x-a/7), P_t(x)=product_(j=0)^6(t+x+j), R_t=P_t-V, L_t=7t+25, F_t=(V(x)P_t(y)-P_t(x)V(y))/(x-y), Bcal_t=F_t-R_t(x)R_t(y)/L_t. The divided difference is a polynomial, also on the diagonal. Let s=r+7 and T=2(I+E_7)^(-1). On degree<=6,

    T=I-(7/2)D+(343/24)D^3-(16807/240)D^5.
    Z_r=[T_xT_y Bcal_s-Bcal_r]_(y=x),
    Xi=L_r L_s(T_xT_y F_s-F_r)
          +L_s R_r(x)R_r(y)-L_r(TR_s)(x)(TR_s)(y).

For each integer k=0,...,6 put q_k(r)=product_(a=1)^7(r+k+a/7), X_k(r)=Xi(r,-r-k,-r-k). The original exact residue identity, including n=6's sign, gives

    G(r)=P(r)/D(r),
    P(r)=sum_k (-1)^k X_k(r) product_(ell!=k)q_ell(r)/[k!(6-k)!],
    D(r)=(7r+25)(7r+74) product_k q_k(r)>0 on[7,8].

No isolated branch, polynomial part or additional normalization is dropped. degP<=14+6*7=56, without assuming actual cancellation or a minimal degree.

For each i=0,...,15 use the PREDECLARED interval [7+i/16,7+(i+1)/16]. If P(a+w u)=sum_(j=0)^56 d_j u^j, its degree56 Bernstein coefficients are

    b_k=sum_(j=0)^k d_j binom(k,j)/binom(56,j).

Then P(a+wu)=sum_k b_k binom(56,k)u^k(1-u)^(56-k). The nonnegative basis sums to1, including endpoints. Strict positivity of ALL16*57=912 exact coefficients proves P>0 and hence the original trace>6 throughout[7,8]. A zero/negative coefficient ONLY means CANNOT_CERTIFY_THIS_FIXED_PLAN. This is a sufficient certificate, not an equivalence with trace positivity. No deeper subdivision, different interval/m, other basis, samples, automatic retry or continued scan follows.

## Concrete algorithms and independence

producer.py uses sparse rational polynomials in(r,x,y). It constructs F by the finite antisymmetric-monomial quotient, applies the displayed derivative polynomial T, constructs Xi, substitutes exactly seven residue nodes, and clears the positive rational coefficient denominator of P. It computes the root[7,8] Bernstein row once, then four exact midpoint de Casteljau levels produce the fixed16 rows.

checker.py imports neither producer nor its polynomial routines. Its carrier is a bivariate(x,y) dictionary of dense r-polynomials. It reconstructs C_t=L_t F_t-R_t(x)R_t(y) by MONIC LONG DIVISION of the original antisymmetric numerator by(x-y), requiring zero remainder. It independently applies T by descending the equation q(x)+q(x+7)=2f(x):

    q_i=f_i-(1/2)sum_(j>i)binom(j,i)7^(j-i)q_j.

It forms Xi=L_r T_xT_y C_s-L_s C_r, rebuilds P from ALL seven residues, and compares every rational power coefficient with the certificate table. It then computes each interval's affine/binomial basis change directly, independently of de Casteljau, and compares every one of912 rational coefficients plus dimensions, interval endpoints, positive denominator factors and declared status. The worker gives it a full serialize/deserialize roundtrip certificate, not shared polynomial objects.

Both implementations have the SAME AUTHOR. Algorithmic independence is a design, not nonauthor review or a Tool/Native vote. New static audit and any admitted independent execution remain separate; old m7 PAPER_PASS supplies neither.

## Whole-job costs, hard stops and files

The original limits are unchanged: ONE construction+check job, <=20,000,000 counted exact operations in TOTAL, <=300s WHOLE-JOB wall, <=512MiB address space, <=8MiB combined emitted output, and <=16384 bits per stored rational numerator/denominator/integer. There is no per-phase reset. Additional integer/constant accounting only makes the operation ceiling stricter. Fractions/gcd/builtin internals are not falsely counted as individual bit operations; the bit, wall and memory caps bound that cost. Loop indices, degree bookkeeping, dictionary lookups/comparisons and byte serialization are outside the exact-arithmetic counter but INSIDE the same wall/memory/output caps.

resource_budget.py charges each rational operation/construction, integer coefficient product/exact division, LCM/binomial/factorial construction and rational encoding/decoding. Powers use charged multiplication. It checks time before arithmetic and stored bit lengths afterward; Linux RLIMIT_AS becomes512MiB or the existing stricter ceiling. A real-time alarm and mandatory external watchdog cover nonarithmetic work. The admitted launcher installs limits BEFORE interpreter/import/parse/hash/compile/preprocessing and passes that original clock to ONE shared Budget. No hidden math precomputation has occurred.

Fixed carrier costs can be audited without running: seven residues;49 affine q-factors; at most816 monomials in a total-degree15 three-variable intermediate; at most57 r-coefficients; two shift inversions on bidegree<=6; one root basis change;15 midpoint splits of a57-entry row (1596 pair averages per split);16 direct checker basis changes, each with1653 affine terms and1653 Bernstein terms;912 encoded rational coefficients. These are structural bounds, not measured performance or a promise to finish below the caps. Rational bit growth/runtime adequacy remains UNKNOWN until an admitted job. A cap causes a truthful BUDGET_STOP/no sign claim, never permission to raise a limit.

All hashing, original-source reads(51407B; hard input carrier bound128KiB), input JSON<=64KiB, module loading/compilation, polynomial construction, basis conversion, certificate serialization, independent reconstruction, output serialization and actual writes count in that same admitted job. No compiler/import smoke test or arithmetic feasibility run precedes admission. Immutable code/input packaging and launcher integration must also be included in the Driver's full preparation/run cost declaration; no generated coefficients, cached polynomial or old run are an input. The full candidate file manifest states actual byte costs; source bodies are already pinned artifacts, not fetched by the science worker. Network access is unnecessary.

workload.py is a non-self-authorizing function, with no CLI. After the genuinely admitted launcher's fresh canonical checks and exact manifest/code/input verification, it may read the fixed input and pinned local source files, call producer and checker, and return ONE bounded JSON byte string. It writes no disk/network output itself. Set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 before interpreter startup; direct compilation of the two definitions creates no __pycache__. The launcher must count its result file, logs, errors, receipts/stdout/stderr together under8MiB, atomically emit only to a new /workspace run directory, and record whole-job final wall/peak-memory/op/output usage. Never use /tmp or mutate original artifacts. No full certificate duplicate is sent to stdout.

OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json and EXECUTION_CONTRACT.json specify exact outputs, failure meanings and the still-missing legal integration. On budget kill, malformed input, code/pin mismatch, exception or checker disagreement, the launcher records the actual stop/failure; no certificate is accepted and no retry is implicit. A valid complete certificate with a nonpositive entry is an honest inconclusive result. A complete verified positive certificate would prove only this fixed interval in the original scalar observer, leaving(8,7^100), other m/gaps/branch masses and the parent OPEN. It cannot close a Task or create a Native result automatically.

## Admission is still missing

No command to run this package is supplied. No allow_run flag, frozen JSON boolean, Root Source lease, direct-activity gate, old Task ID, predecessor run or this README grants execution. That Driver must provide the actual fresh binding, exact permitted executor/session, immutable code+input+manifest references, safe launcher and complete budget accounting; the author must consume and verify the real receipts before invocation. This preparation does not assert such a record already exists.

Read-only registry/inventory and bounded source-file searches support task-local classical polynomial/Bernstein composition under existing finite-certificate semantics; they prove no global tool absence or new Tool family. Native X6/static scalar-observer typing and original branch/source provenance remain intact, without native plane/time or positive-to-signed claims.
